subject: STABLE (host) P2+P1: scheduled at submission + depth-2 throttle in compute_frontend.m; plan memo 16 ways; overlay-tested on HEAD+mine
body: compute_frontend.m (my hunks only; others' TEGU_PERF_RT hunks untouched): a pipelined command (tail.deferred: async, finish FIFO, no CPU shadow write-back) sets status=scheduled and runs its scheduled handlers right after its last job is submitted; teguFinishReport (GPU completion, presents, completion handlers) unchanged and decrements queue->earlyInflight. P1: a 3rd early command waits while 2 are unfinished, max 100 ms (clock; host without clock: bounded backoff), counted as TEGU_PERF_FRAME early_wait/early_forced. Off: NORD2_METAL_EARLY_SCHEDULED=0 or -DTEGU_EARLY_SCHEDULED_DEFAULT=0. It only takes effect where pipelining is on (A/B AP=1 or -DTEGU_ASYNC_PIPELINE_DEFAULT=1) - ROOT: for the device build choose -DTEGU_ASYNC_PIPELINE_DEFAULT=1 to ship P2 (needs kernel 0097(c) GPU-complete present gating, present in P7; 0100 wait-without-connection-lock (P8) makes it overlap fully, without it the next SUBMIT queues behind the FIFO's WAIT_SEQ but CA is still released at submission; 0102 level 2 bounds swap run-ahead). Bridge declares every render target incl. imported surfaces in write_mask (add_ref(...,1)), so 0097(c) sees them. Test build/encode-cpu-20261026/async_frontend_test.py: FA_PIPE now expects scheduled=3 before any reap, new FA_EARLY (third command throttled 102-104 ms then forced; open FIFO: no forced wait), fake kernel calls serialized (the fake is single-threaded; ASan found the race in the fake, not the frontend): 3x PASS asan+release. Gate run in a private overlay tree (gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/tree = git archive HEAD + only my hunks: ov_rp/ov_re/ov_cf.patch) because the shared tree currently does not compile (others' in-flight edits: nord2_render_resources.inc 'redefinition of bh', earlier XR symbols). Hashes: compute_frontend.m (working tree incl. others) as listed by sha on request; overlay patches in gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/. Next: translator patch adoption (fold + compiler-speed decode-reuse/fingerprint), FunctionCompileKey reuse, LTO, rebuilds, gates.
